chapters.name: Begin with breakfast
chapters.top: rippling wheat awns and oat stems linked by loose flour-like stipples, irregular arcs suggesting a breakfast plate
chapters.bottom: an informal breakfast still life: a shallow bowl of apple porridge, torn flatbread and one apple cut across its core
chapters.surface: pale oat-coloured paper with a quiet suggestion of limewashed breakfast-table wood

chapters.name: Milk, two ways
chapters.top: airy meadow-grass stems and tiny dairy-meadow blossoms, flowing pale cream curls as ornamental strokes
chapters.bottom: a white milk jug, a small cultured-yogurt bowl with fruit, and a freshly churned butter pat on a modest dish
chapters.surface: cool ivory enamel-like wash, fine grey-blue flecks, almost white
chapters.tableclothDescription: a pale blue-and-ivory checked tablecloth draped beneath the jug, yogurt dish and butter dish, broad enough to join the separate vessels into one breakfast setting

chapters.name: A loaf worth buttering
chapters.top: loose rising-dough arcs and grain stalks interlaced with crumb-like stipples, a gently broken bread-scoring rhythm
chapters.bottom: a cut round crusty loaf with two uneven slices and a butter curl, a few crumbs falling loosely
chapters.surface: pale warm beech wood grain, broad and sparse rather than ruled planks

chapters.name: Yogurt, thick and fresh
chapters.top: a trailing cucumber vine with tiny blossoms and delicate branching dill umbels, thin feathery connected linework
chapters.bottom: a sprawling cucumber vine, cucumber slices, a bowl of thick herbed yogurt and one torn flatbread corner
chapters.surface: very pale celadon paper with a cool clean milk-white central wash

chapters.name: A little sharpness
chapters.top: an airy apple-blossom branch interwoven with olive-leaf curls, tiny abstract vinegar-drop stipples
chapters.bottom: apple blossoms and an apple branch beside a slender amber vinegar cruet, olive leaves and loosely dressed lettuce
chapters.surface: pale green-grey stone-like wash with softly mottled mineral texture

chapters.name: Toast and warm apples
chapters.top: curling apple-peel ribbons woven with thyme-like branching stems, warm pale gold and muted leaf green
chapters.bottom: herb-flecked toast leaning casually beside a bowl of white yogurt with golden apple compote, soft steam in the margin
chapters.surface: warm pale honey-oak surface with barely visible grain

chapters.name: A pot of broth
goals: Serve onion soup with herb toast.
chapters.top: fine nested onion-ring arcs opening into leek-leaf ribbons and fragrant steam curls, pale golden-grey flowing lines
chapters.bottom: an onion-soup bowl with a floating herb toast, a leek and a loose onion skin; a few lines suggest fragrant steam
chapters.surface: pale mushroom-grey soapstone wash with a slight warm undertone

chapters.name: Roots, beans and crisp edges
goals: Fill flatbread with roots and beans.
chapters.top: beet-leaf veins, curling bean tendrils and tiny seed-pod rhythms, subdued plum and green tracery
chapters.bottom: a folded flatbread showing roasted parsnip, beet and white beans, with a loose scatter of croutons and a turnip; one modest carrot may be included among the roots
chapters.surface: pale clay-cream paper with diffuse terracotta warmth toward the lower edge

chapters.name: A salad wants contrast
chapters.top: approved mustard-and-leaf tracery
chapters.bottom: a free loose still life of ruffled lettuce, red chicory, crisp croutons, a mustard flower and a shallow bowl of roasted-root salad
chapters.surface: very light sage linen texture, irregular threads almost disappearing into the central field

chapters.name: One sheet, two pastas
chapters.top: flowing parallel pasta-ribbon lines looping into occasional scalloped ravioli-edge rhythms, sparse egg-shell-like flecks
chapters.bottom: a tumble of broad egg-pasta ribbons and a few filled ravioli on a flour-dusted surface, one broken eggshell at the side
chapters.surface: cool white marble pastry slab, restrained blue-grey diagonal veins at the outer margins and a few extremely faint veins across the otherwise open centre

chapters.name: Pasta at the table
chapters.top: light parsley stems interlaced with sweeping noodle-like ornamental pen loops and breadcrumb-like dots
chapters.bottom: a simple plate of ravioli with herb butter beside a loose forkful of noodles and toasted breadcrumbs
chapters.surface: pale chalk-white table linen with a slight warm cream cast

chapters.name: Two ways with butter
chapters.top: approved wheat and pastry-layer flourishes
chapters.bottom: a rolled sheet of shortcrust, a partially folded rectangle of laminated dough, small cold butter cubes and scattered flour; observational pastry-making study
chapters.surface: distinctly cool white Carrara marble pastry slab with blue-grey branching veins, visible but very light and low contrast, no yellow parchment cast

chapters.name: What pastry can hold
chapters.top: loose crimped-pastry scallops and twisting layered pen ribbons, occasional apple-leaf curls and faint cheese-gold flecks
chapters.bottom: a small open bean pie, a cut apple tart and a few puff-pastry shards, varied shapes arranged as a loose baker's tasting study
chapters.surface: pale cool marble with a barely lavender-grey undertone and sparse delicate veins

chapters.name: The sauce page
chapters.top: a pale continuous sauce-ribbon flourish, loose whisk-wire arcs and delicate milky droplets, elegant light abstract penwork
chapters.bottom: a simple sauceboat pouring a soft ribbon beside a small wedge of cheese, a little milk jug and a pinch of flour
chapters.surface: pale blue-white enamel worktop, softly luminous with minimal fine wear marks

chapters.name: A vegetable supper
chapters.top: branching cauliflower-like lacy florets merging into curled green leaf veins, broad airy gaps
chapters.bottom: a whole partly cut cauliflower beside an oval golden gratin, an exposed spoonful showing its florets, and a few wide cooked noodles
chapters.surface: soft warm grey limestone with tiny quiet mineral speckles

chapters.name: Fruit, sugar and time
goals: Prepare fruit syrup for later pages.
chapters.top: loose citrus-peel spirals linked to tiny orange blossoms and berry-vine tendrils, pale apricot and rose accents
chapters.bottom: a cut orange with translucent segments, a ribbon of peel, berries and an open dish of amber marmalade beside a spoon of red soft-set jam
chapters.surface: pale apricot-tinted paper, subtly varied with a light warm pink wash

chapters.name: Tarts from earlier pages
chapters.top: an irregular broken lattice rhythm of pastry-like pen ribbons intertwined with apple blossom and tiny berry stems
chapters.bottom: a cut lattice jam tart and a shallow apple crumble with its spoonful lifted, loose apple peel and crumbs trailing off
chapters.surface: pale rose-grey stone pastry surface with a few gentle veins

chapters.name: Almonds ground fine
goals: Fill puff pastry with almond paste.
chapters.top: a graceful almond twig with narrow leaves, a few small blossoms and almond-shaped ornamental loops, pale warm brown
chapters.bottom: an almond twig with green husks and one blossom, split dates filled with marzipan, and a cut almond-filled puff showing its layers
chapters.surface: pale almond-milk paper with a faint warm linen grain

chapters.name: Sugar taken further
chapters.top: thin translucent amber curls and broken crystalline facets joined with fine almond-leaf pen tracery
chapters.bottom: irregular pieces of almond brittle and a little cream jug beside a spoon trailing caramel, warm amber light through the thin sugar
chapters.surface: cool pearl-grey marble confectioner's slab with delicate subtle veining

chapters.name: A sauce and a filling
chapters.top: slender vanilla vines with tiny blossoms and pale looping custard-like lines, very soft butter yellow
chapters.bottom: a shallow bowl of golden custard and a spoon holding a firmer mound of pastry cream, two yolks in a broken eggshell and a milk jug
chapters.surface: very pale butter-yellow ceramic wash with a creamy white central field
chapters.tableclothDescription: a soft faded ochre-striped linen tablecloth under the custard bowl, jug, spoon and eggshells, the whole low arrangement grounded in its broad connected folds

chapters.name: Bread soaked, pastry filled
chapters.top: gentle apple-and-berry blossom branches intertwined with bread-crust scallops and a few caramel-coloured wisps
chapters.bottom: a square of caramel bread pudding beside a cut fruit-and-cream tart, exposed cream layer and a few browned bread corners
chapters.surface: pale warm peach linen, just a suggestion of woven fibres

chapters.name: Steam does the lifting
chapters.top: airy loops of rising steam and little expanding hollow circular pen forms suggesting the lift of choux, soft gold
chapters.bottom: a loose cluster of golden hollow choux shells, one sliced open wide, beside a few cheese puffs and a light wisp of steam
chapters.surface: pale oat-grey baking parchment wash, softly mottled without stains or lettering

chapters.name: Inside a choux bun
chapters.top: loose cream-like scalloped swirls threaded with very fine amber caramel strands, irregular and airy
chapters.bottom: a cut cream puff with a cloud of white filling and a caramel-topped custard-filled choux bun, a loose caramel thread and a plain bun nearby
chapters.surface: pale porcelain-white marble with a cool faint grey-blue cast

chapters.name: Cake lightened with air
chapters.top: flowing whisk-wire loops opening into fine bubble-like rings and a light dotted crumb rhythm, pale gold and cocoa grey
chapters.bottom: a slice of plain golden sponge and a slice of cocoa sponge, their porous crumb clearly observed, with a cracked egg and a faint cocoa dusting
chapters.surface: very pale golden eggshell paper with a soft airy white central wash

chapters.name: A roll and a spoonful
chapters.top: broken jam-spiral pen curls and berry tendrils woven into an uneven horizontal ornament, pale blush rose
chapters.bottom: a sliced jam roll and a glass trifle revealing cake, custard, apple and cream layers; loose crumbs and a spoon at the edge
chapters.surface: pale blush-white table linen, minimal texture

chapters.name: Begin with chocolate
chapters.top: branching cacao leaves, tiny cacao blossoms and gently ribbed elongated pod-like arcs, soft warm grey and muted brown
chapters.bottom: a split cacao pod, several roasted beans, a broken dark chocolate slab and a small glossy pool of ganache in a bowl
chapters.surface: pale neutral cocoa-grey stone with subtle mineral variation, centre almost ivory

chapters.name: Chocolate, three finishes
goals: Fill a chocolate cake with ganache.
chapters.top: fine cocoa-leaf sprays braided with delicate chocolate-ribbon curls and tiny almond-blossom marks
chapters.bottom: a cut ganache-filled chocolate cake, two chocolate profiteroles and a split chocolate-coated marzipan sweet, loose cocoa leaves
chapters.surface: pale dove-grey marble with subdued sparse veins

chapters.name: Scones for tea
chapters.top: approved strawberry-runner border
chapters.bottom: a split scone carrying red jam and thick cream beside two plain scones and a small cup of hot chocolate, an informal afternoon-tea still life
chapters.surface: pale cream tea-table linen with faint irregular blue threads near the margins
chapters.tableclothDescription: the approved blue-and-white striped tea tablecloth

chapters.name: Bread without waiting
chapters.top: scoring-cross pen rhythms linked by wheat awns and small berry-bearing twigs, pale gold and blue-purple flecks
chapters.bottom: a rustic cross-scored soda loaf cut to reveal a close crumb beside two fruit muffins and a small yogurt bowl
chapters.surface: very pale flour-dusted beech board with quiet warm grain and no hard board edge

chapters.name: Cold changes things
chapters.top: a faint frosty fan of delicate vanilla vines and berry-leaf tracery, airy icy-blue curves and pale pink flecks
chapters.bottom: three modest bowls: pale vanilla frozen custard, vivid fruit sorbet and milk-white ice cream, with berries and a vanilla pod; distinct textures
chapters.surface: cool pale ice-blue marble with delicate soft grey veins, noticeably colder than the baking pages

chapters.name: The egg-white pages
chapters.top: whipped-foam curls, tiny air-bubble rings and narrow almond leaves forming a loose pale lilac-grey pen frieze
chapters.bottom: a white fruit-filled meringue nest and a few chocolate macarons, one split to reveal the ganache, loose eggshell and almond fragments
chapters.surface: very pale lilac-grey paper washed almost white through the centre

chapters.name: Ice cream dressed for dinner
chapters.top: flowing toasted-gold meringue-peak arcs dissolving into frosty blue pen wisps and sparse sauce-coloured dots
chapters.bottom: a cut Baked Alaska revealing cake and ice cream beneath toasted meringue, beside a small glass sundae with a sauce ribbon
chapters.surface: cool pale silvery-blue stone with a few subdued mineral veins

chapters.name: What keeping really means
chapters.top: apple-blossom tracery and loose circular jar-rim rhythms with tiny branching bean-leaf tendrils, pale sage and gold
chapters.bottom: an opened jar of golden apple pieces, a small bowl of fruit with pouring custard, and an unlabelled sealed food tin among loose apple leaves; no process diagram
chapters.surface: pale sage-white enamel with softly worn grey texture

chapters.name: Supper from the notebook
goals: Serve bean stew with soda bread.
Finish a cake for the tasting supper.
chapters.top: quiet bean-vine tendrils and wheat stems intertwined with a broken scalloped plate-rim rhythm
chapters.bottom: a generous bowl of bean stew with cut soda bread and two modest cake slices, one pale vanilla and one dark chocolate, set together as a supper study
chapters.surface: warm ivory tablecloth with barely visible natural linen weave
chapters.tableclothDescription: a quiet natural linen supper tablecloth with a few faded brick-red woven stripes, broad draping folds beneath the stew bowl, cut bread and cake

chapters.name: The tasting table
goals: Bring the tasting supper to the service hatch.
chapters.top: fine thyme sprigs linked by loose pencil-like ornamental strokes and interrupted plate-rim arcs, no writing
chapters.bottom: an open blank kitchen notebook with a resting pencil, a used tasting plate, a small glass of apple juice and scattered bread crumbs; a quiet end-of-meal still life
chapters.surface: pale blue-white linen, soft and welcoming with faint warm light at the bottom
